goal: Coordinate an Idea-Spark discussion-until-gate review in default CLI-first mode. Use `hermes idea-spark call <operation> --json-file <payload>` for room operations unless explicit tool-mode has been enabled and the Hermes session reset. After room creation, report the returned room_url only after dashboard_reachable=true or another health check passes; otherwise report the dashboard_warning and room_id instead of a dead link. Join/read the room state, then launch bounded child phases outside the plugin CLI/tool handlers. Use fixed phase order: r0/seed (Seed / Framing); r1/review (Novelty Attack); r2/rebuttal (Author Rebuttal / Improvement Draft); r3/re-review (Re-review / Cross-examination); r4/gate (Gate); final/handoff. Maintain idea_spark_phase_ledger.md in the current working directory. After each nonterminal phase, call idea_spark_room_status, verify messages/artifacts, update the phase ledger with a stage checkpoint marker, re-read skill_view(name="idea-spark:idea-spark-usage"), and continue while has_terminal_gate=false. Gatekeeper must call idea_spark_gate_record with close_room=true for the terminal gate. A message-only gate is not final. If evidence remains insufficient, record needs_more_evidence as the terminal gate at r4. Use idea_spark_room_export for auditability only; write any researcher-facing handoff as a detailed standalone Markdown report in the current working directory, not only under /tmp. Do not call skill_manage.
context: room_id=<ROOM_ID>; dashboard_room_url=<ROOM_URL>; idea_summary=<IDEA_SUMMARY>; payload_scratch_root=/tmp/idea_spark_<RUN_ID>/; handoff_path=idea_spark_handoffs/<RUN_ID>_handoff.md; required placeholders to replace before use: <ROOM_ID>, <ROOM_URL>, <IDEA_SUMMARY>, <RUN_ID>. Default child roles use toolsets=["terminal", "file", "skills"] and write JSON payloads under payload_scratch_root/<agent_id>/ for `hermes idea-spark call`. Explicit tool-mode child roles may use toolsets=["idea_spark", "skills"] only after `$HERMES_HOME/idea-spark/config.json` enables tools and the session reset. Children must call idea_spark_room_join first, load skill_view(name="idea-spark:idea-spark-usage") when protocol details are needed, write at least one message and one typed artifact when substantive content exists, use phase/phase="*"/phases=[...] for round_wait barriers, use idea_spark_need_create / idea_spark_need_update for evidence gaps, and never treat summaries or messages as final gates. Parent must continue r1->r2->r3->r4 until has_terminal_gate=true, then write the standalone handoff report to handoff_path.
